request.style: English, warm male solo with soft choir, piano, acoustic guitar, strings, gentle percussion, reverent and hopeful, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart
Not climbing up to heaven or down into the abyss
We do not need to reach for Christ from the dead
The faith we proclaim is close and clearly set

[Chorus]
Confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord
Believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead
You will be saved, for this is the way
Righteousness comes to those who believe and say

[Verse]
With the heart one believes, resulting in righteousness
With the mouth one confesses, resulting in salvation
No one who believes in him will be put to shame
The Lord is rich with gifts, calling out the same

[Chorus]
Confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord
Believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead
You will be saved, for this is the way
Righteousness comes to those who believe and say

[Bridge]
No distinction between the Jew and the Greek
The same Lord is Lord of all, as the Scripture speaks
He pours out his riches on all who call
Faithful is the Lord, standing by his hall

[Chorus]
Confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord
Believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead
You will be saved, for this is the way
Righteousness comes to those who believe and say

[Outro]
Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord
Will be saved, for faith is the word
